services.documentsDescription: Before you start, ensure you have the following ready:

step1.title: Select Your Vehicle
step1.description: Browse our selection and connect with a sales representative via our website, WhatsApp, hotline, or visit us in person.

step2.title: Book an Inspection
step2.description: Schedule an in-yard inspection to ensure the vehicle meets your standards and requirements.

step3.title: Verification
step3.description: Verify the vehicle details before proceeding.

step4.title: Quotation
step4.description: Request a proforma invoice from our sales team.

step5.title: Confirmation
step5.description: Finalize the payment transfer and share the transfer confirmation with us.

step6.title: Documentation & Release
step6.description: Complete the ownership transfer and receive your vehicle.
items: Complete the ownership transfer through your active NTSA TIMS account
Receive the original logbook from the seller
Prepare the vehicle, ensuring all necessary accessories and tools are in order
Complete a car wash and detailing
Hand over the vehicle to you, the proud new owner

finance.title: Asset Finance
finance.documentsDescription: To apply for asset finance, have these documents ready:

step1.title: Check Eligibility
step1.description: Confirm eligibility with your preferred financiers, whether it's a bank, SACCO, or microfinance institution. Our sales agents are available to assist.

step2.title: Submit Documents
step2.description: Provide all necessary documents to your chosen financier and obtain confirmation of your finance eligibility.

step3.title: Vehicle Reservation
step3.description: Reserve your vehicle with a down payment.

step4.title: Finance Approval
step4.description: Work with your financier to get approval for your loan.

step5.title: Undertaking / Release Letter
step5.description: Complete the final steps for vehicle release.
items: Complete your portion of the payment
The seller will finalize the ownership transfer and submit any remaining documents

about.subtitle: Experience the Freedom of the Open Road
about.description: Experience the thrill of the open road with Motor Hut. Explore our diverse lineup of innovative vehicles, meticulously crafted for every adventure, big or small. Whether you crave the power and versatility of our SUVs, the sleek sophistication of our sedans, or the rugged dependability of our trucks, Motor Hut has the perfect driving companion to match your lifestyle.
